definitions.explanation: To set fire to something or dispose of by burning.

notes:
{燃|も}やす is a transitive godan verb meaning to burn something deliberately.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {燃|も}える (intransitive, to burn by itself)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ゴミを{燃|も}やす: to burn garbage
- {落|お}ち{葉|ば}を{燃|も}やす: to burn fallen leaves
- {書類|しょるい}を{燃|も}やす: to burn documents

GARBAGE SORTING:
- {燃|も}えるゴミ/{可燃|かねん}ゴミ: combustible garbage
- {燃|も}えないゴミ/{不燃|ふねん}ゴミ: non-combustible garbage

FIGURATIVE USE:
- {情熱|じょうねつ}を{燃|も}やす: to burn with passion
- {闘志|とうし}を{燃|も}やす: to be fired up (for competition)

RELATED:
- {燃|も}える: to burn (intransitive)
- {焼|や}く: to grill, roast, bake
